sampling.pairing: all required arms are paired pre-treatment clones within life
sampling.within_life: equal-weight arithmetic mean over every prospectively assigned lower unit
sampling.across_life: equal-weight arithmetic mean over every sealed recipient life

missing.benefit_contrast: For treatment-minus-control with higher beneficial, substitute finite_min for missing treatment and finite_max for missing control; if both are missing apply both substitutions.
missing.lower_better_contrast: Orient every safety contrast as control-minus-treatment benefit, then apply the same adverse substitution rule.
missing.rate: For each claim and arm, numerator is sealed recipient lives with at least one required missing observation; denominator is all assigned recipient lives.
missing.limit: A rate greater than the run-locked threshold blocks; equality is allowed.

paired_randomization.statistic: For each named treatment-control gate, compute within-life benefit d_i after adverse substitution and lower-unit aggregation; observed statistic is mean_i(d_i - margin).
paired_randomization.distribution: Enumerate all 2^N within-life label swaps. For swap vector s_i in {-1,+1}, statistic is mean_i(s_i * (d_i - margin)).
paired_randomization.p_value: Count enumerated statistics greater than or equal to the observed statistic, including the observed assignment, divided by 2^N.
paired_randomization.interval: Invert the same exact test over the run-locked finite margin grid; report the closed set of margins not rejected. The grid is numeric run-lock content; the inversion algorithm is fixed here.
paired_randomization.tie_rule: greater than or equal counts against release

D1A.benefit: locked false-selection ceiling minus READER_LORA false_selection_rate
locked NOT_FOUND ceiling minus READER_LORA not_found_rate

D1B.benefit: AUTHENTIC_PATH normalized_action_value minus each edge-specific CUT value
D1B.kind: one gate per edge position; all required

D1B.benefit: AUTHENTIC_PATH normalized_action_value minus each edge-specific TWIN value
D1B.kind: one gate per edge position; all required
noninferiority; demonstrates intervention machinery alone is not harmful

assay_decision.direction_margin_rule: Every named gate's observed benefit must be strictly greater than its run-locked margin.
assay_decision.intersection_union_p: If every direction/margin rule passes, assay_p is max of all named gate p-values, expanding every per-edge gate separately. Otherwise assay blocks.
assay_decision.safety: Safety gates are conjunctive and never descriptive substitutes.
assay_decision.missing: Missingness limit is conjunctive for every required arm.
assay_decision.blockers: CONSTRUCTION_FAIL or RUN_INVALID blocks the dependent assay before inference.

family.procedure: Holm step-down on four assay p-values ascending; claim_id lexicographic tie-break.
family.thresholds: At ordered position j in 1..4, reject while p_(j) <= alpha/(5-j); stop at first failure and retain it and all later hypotheses.
family.intersection: The four-assay label releases only if all four assay claims reject and all global gates pass; it adds no fifth test.

power.purpose: Conservative pre-run familywise probability that all four assays release.
power.algorithm: For each gate, compute the exact binomial probability that its conservative one-sided favorable-sign count p-value is at most alpha/4 after replacing a life with failure whenever its required arm is missing. Let power_g be that probability. Familywise lower bound is max(0, 1 - sum_g(1-power_g)). Use the worst registered input scenario. Pre-model authority requires lower bound >= the locked floor.
power.scope: This is a conservative design gate, not the primary inference method and not an observed-data analysis.

resource_accounting.inclusive: Each cell includes every dependency and counts a shared DREAM event fully for each dependent cell.
resource_accounting.marginal: Shared physical work is recorded once under presealed SHARED_DREAM; a cell records only incremental work.
resource_accounting.physical_total: Deduplicate by event_id and shared_event_id before summing.
resource_accounting.claim_role: Reported treatment dose/outcome only; no normalization, regression, or Pareto result gates a causal release.
